what_it_is: DNA is an Australian monthly for gay men that mixes news features, celebrity interviews, pop-culture reviews and long reads on LGBTQIA+ life with extensive male model and fashion photography. Each issue runs a cover interview, a themed long-form piece and several photographic portfolios. It suits readers wanting a glossy, pin-up-led gay lifestyle title with an Australian base and international distribution.
